acceptance.duplicate_gate: Versioned domain-tagged semantic-core key derived before writes; best-effort repository search must return zero matches. The prior v41 recovery token must resolve to exactly one Slack message; a retry must not create a second v41 recovery post.
acceptance.pointer_gate: Commit and read back this immutable event; fetch CURRENT again; update only if version=41, projection digest=d90b3a97f2b4c0bc0f9194ca5d9e0308a215858c0c51566c4b9699a29ae0d5a3, and blob=83cb4d767f911d25081b44acbaeb9c4c60fd959b; then read back CURRENT, this event, and predecessor.
acceptance.slack_rule: Before Git writes, search the exact v41 recovery token and require exactly one match. Suppress the duplicate v41 recovery retry. After v42 Git readback, post exactly one sanitized v42 version-advance pointer; do not rewrite CURRENT merely to embed the Slack link.
acceptance.stale_rule: Any wake not observing exact v41, prior digest c7dd8a82..., projection digest d90b3a97..., and blob 83cb4d76... must not advance.

experiment.controlled_factor: Keep event canonicalization, v3 semantic-core idempotency, event-first write/readback, exact second CURRENT read, and single-file blob-SHA guard fixed; vary only the recovery retry condition from confirmed absence to an already-present exact v41 Slack recovery token.
experiment.hypothesis: A retry after the v41 Slack projection already exists can detect the exact recovery token, suppress a duplicate v41 post, and still advance the independent Git-backed object to v42 with one new post-advance pointer.
experiment.strongest_falsifier: The proposed idempotency key already exists; the exact v41 recovery token resolves to zero or more than one Slack message; a duplicate v41 recovery post is emitted; CURRENT is not exact v41 on the second read; event digest recomputation fails; or final chain bindings disagree.

canonical_transition.honest_flaw: This is a same-carrier, immediate retry-dedup specimen using one exact Slack token search, not a process crash, delayed replay, distinct carrier, real outage, or server-enforced unique key. Slack search may lag or omit messages; exactly one result is not a consistent global uniqueness proof. Git event creation, CURRENT replacement, validation reads, Slack search, and Slack posting are separate effects. Git provides no cross-file atomicity, database isolation, linearizability, exactly-once execution, referential integrity, server-side idempotency uniqueness, Slack atomicity, lock fairness, or automatic orphan repair.
canonical_transition.rollback: Append a compensating event from the then-current version; never delete this event or any Slack pointer; replace CURRENT only with its exact then-current blob SHA.
canonical_transition.transaction_time_evidence: AUTOMATION_RUNTIME_CLOCK+NATIVE_TASK_INVENTORY_READBACK+GITHUB_COMMIT_METADATA; Slack search/post and Git writes are not one transaction boundary
